summary: Frontend-only E2E verification of the 4 new features on Techin By Raj. ALL PASSED: (1) Real TradingView candlestick chart renders inside data-testid='signal-chart' (s.tradingview.com/widgetembed iframe present, window.TradingView loaded, BTCUSDT 1H candles visible in screenshot). (2) Buyer flow — trader@example.com login 200, /dashboard shows owned-indicator_pro with 1 download button; click issued GET /api/assets/{id}/download -> 200, no error toast. (3) Admin flow — raj@techinbyraj.com login 200, admin-panel renders at bottom of /dashboard with all 3 per-product uploaders; uploaded a .txt via admin-title/admin-file/admin-upload-btn-indicator_pro -> POST /api/admin/products/indicator_pro/assets 200, 'File uploaded' toast shown, new file 'TEST_QA_File' appeared in the card list; deleted afterwards via admin-delete (cleanup successful). (4) Landing header shows new SVG logo mark in data-testid='brand-logo'; hero copy contains 'fully customisable' and 'beginner and pro traders'; pricing shows '5 dynamic targets' and '1-on-1 doubt solving'. Admin panel correctly hidden for the non-admin buyer. Also ran the auth playbook spot-checks per instructions.

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout. Verified by curl: 6 consecutive wrong-password attempts for raj@techinbyraj.com all returned 401 and a valid login immediately after returned 200. Playbook requires lockout after 5 failed attempts.

allow_credentials=True with fallback allow_origins=['*'] when FRONTEND_URL is unset — browsers reject wildcard+credentials. Env is currently set so it works, but the fallback should fail fast instead.
Hardcoded defaults ADMIN_EMAIL='admin@example.com' / ADMIN_PASSWORD='admin123'. Should read env without insecure defaults. (Update-existing-admin-on-password-change logic itself is correct.)

issues: Native <input type=file> uses the browser default 'Choose File' control which looks off-brand against the dark #E2FF4A theme (file: pseudo-styles applied but the OS button text is still default).
Uploaded-file rows and 'No files yet.' use text-zinc-600 on #0A0A0A — very low contrast.

action_items: Add brute-force lockout (5 failed attempts) on /api/auth/login per auth playbook.
Remove insecure fallbacks: CORS allow_origins ['*'] and ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD defaults — fail fast if env missing.
Optional: increase contrast of admin file-list text (zinc-600 -> zinc-400).
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx: <AdminPanel products={products} onChange={loadLibrary} /> passes onChange but AdminPanel({ products }) ignores it, and AdminProductUploader never calls it — so after an admin upload/delete the admin's own 'Your library' section is not refreshed. Dead prop / stale UI.
Dashboard.jsx downloadAsset(): errors are swallowed into a generic 'Download failed' toast with no status-code distinction (403 vs 404 vs 500) and no loading state on the download button.
AdminProductUploader.upload(): no client-side file size/type validation before POST; a large file will just hang on the disabled button.
SignalChart.jsx: loads third-party script from s3.tradingview.com with no onerror handler — if the CDN is blocked the chart area silently stays empty with no fallback message.

success_rate.backend: n/a (skipped per request; auth playbook spot-checks only)

seed_data_creation: Uploaded and then deleted a temp asset 'TEST_QA_File' under indicator_pro. No residual test data.
test_credentials: raj@techinbyraj.com / Techin@2026 (admin) and trader@example.com / Trader@123 (owner) both verified working; cookie set with HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=None; Partitioned.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new features (TradingView chart, buyer download, admin uploader, brand/hero copy) verified working end-to-end via Playwright on the public URL. Lenis must be destroyed (window.__lenis.destroy()) before using scrollIntoView. Remaining open items are backend hardening only: missing login rate-limit/lockout, wildcard CORS fallback, hardcoded admin creds defaults, and the dead onChange prop on AdminPanel.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects reproduced. The brute-force gap is a genuine absence of any attempt counter/lockout in the login handler (no failed_attempts/locked_until fields in server.py).
